title: After-hours Invisalign enquiry: qualifies it and texts the online booking link when asked
caller_turns: Hi, I know it's late, I'm interested in Invisalign. Can I book a consultation somehow?
Yes please, text me the booking link to this number.

expect.intent: Confirms the booking link has been texted (or, if sending failed, offers another way such as a callback). Does not claim the practice is open right now.
